insights: Spotify uses a consistent pill-shaped (rounded-full) button pattern across all CTAs with scale(1.04) hover transform for tactile feedback, creating a bouncy, playful interaction feel.

The dark theme relies heavily on opacity and color value hierarchy (#FFFFFF for primary, #B3B3B3 for secondary, #939393 for tertiary) rather than different hues, letting album art be the primary color source.

Mobile-first horizontal scroll carousels with CSS snap scrolling are the dominant content discovery pattern, with staggered slide-in animations creating perceived speed and delight during navigation transitions.
